experiment: THOR P2 relay credit, WINDOW_UPDATE policy, response-event size and ACK pipelining

control.name: control
control.description: Protocol default: 64 KiB window, 64 KiB/2 ms credit updates, 16 KiB events, ACK awaited inline.

credit-window-128k.name: credit-window-128k
credit-window-128k.description: Control plus a 128 KiB total read window granted right after STREAM_STARTED.

credit-window-256k.name: credit-window-256k
credit-window-256k.description: Control plus the maximum 256 KiB total read window granted right after STREAM_STARTED.

credit-policy-32k-1ms.name: credit-policy-32k-1ms
credit-policy-32k-1ms.description: Control with finer credit updates: 32 KiB batch, 1 ms deadline flush.

credit-policy-128k-4ms.name: credit-policy-128k-4ms
credit-policy-128k-4ms.description: Control with coarser credit updates: 128 KiB batch, 4 ms deadline flush.

events-32k.name: events-32k
events-32k.description: Control with 32 KiB destination reads and a 32 KiB client event bound.

events-64k.name: events-64k
events-64k.description: Control with 64 KiB destination reads and a 64 KiB client event bound.

credit-policy-window-aware.name: credit-policy-window-aware
credit-policy-window-aware.description: Control with the deadline flush gated by outstanding credit: no WINDOW_UPDATE while the relay still holds at least half the window (bounded and deadlock-free; the 2 ms deadline still applies above it).

ack-pipeline.name: ack-pipeline
ack-pipeline.description: Control with the WINDOW_UPDATE acknowledgement validated off the read path (single-flight, bounded backlog, same relay-side credit limits).

metadata.warning: Loopback only, one host, relays in the same Python process. No WAN, Tor, anonymity or 90%-of-Surface claim follows from these numbers.
